title: Patient-Centered Clinical Trial Navigation: Addressing Gender Disparity in Clinical Trial Participation
official: Patient-Centered Clinical Trial Navigation: Addressing Gender Disparity in Clinical Trial Participation
summary: This is a two-arm, open-label, randomized interventional study involving women newly diagnosed with breast cancer.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years.
* Female patients who have a new breast cancer diagnosis with no prior treatment.
* Proficient in the English Language.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any prior cancer treatment.
* A cancer recurrence or previously treated cancer.
* Any prior participation in a clinical trial.
